source_access_method.allowed: Anonymous HTTPS HEAD of exact archive DOI and declared repository landing URLs. At most 8KiB of HTML metadata GET, only if needed after failed HEAD, and only for original known landing URL.
source_access_method.forbidden: No Movebank tracking event API, GPS CSV, dataset payload ZIP, hidden coordinate endpoints, credential use, automatic terms acceptance, license bypass, or unverified URL scraping
source_access_method.do_not_assume: A CC0 DataCite DOI means public license metadata, not proof the current file server allows direct anonymous event download

registered_science_gate.target: Predeparture conspecific opportunity x remaining downstream route/time adjustment, as a hypothesis not an executed test
registered_science_gate.past_work: Brønnvik et al. 2024, Current Biology 34:2030–2037.e3, 158 tracked birds (up to 9 years), estimated social hotspots from 400 storks, showed age decline in conspecific-density route selection.
registered_science_gate.not_novel: Social preference for conspecific routes, preference declining with experience, delayed cohort's altered migration distance/flight/survival and learning-refinement in storks
required_to_open_any_new_result: Authorized original timestamped tracking events from all three source cohorts; each source study's terms/CC0 verified at file boundary
A separate, timestamped social opportunity surface constructed from birds not used as the focal choice response, excluding future observations and self-inclusion
Focal decision time/location and available route alternatives with recourse independently defined from movement outcome
Independent predecision cue predictive reliability q for subsequent resource/environment state; tagged-neighbor density is only exposure opportunity, not q
Specific causal or out-of-year estimand absent from Bontekoe 2023, Brønnvik 2024, Aikens 2024 prior results
Same-focal-bird event and outcome join with correct cohorts/years; no cross-study bird identity inferred from matching names or regions
registered_science_gate.decision_rule: Current metadata or old archive landing access cannot validate animal-level q x recourse; classify only source transport, not ecological effect

public_dspace_bundle_metadata_gate.interpretation: Files named GPS/CSV or with public size do not prove data access, schema, time alignment, social information or cue reliability.
